description: Unit test class for the DefaultMetadataHeaders class, validating parsing, JSON serialization, equality, and sorting behavior.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeadersTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of DefaultMetadataHeaders, including equals/hashCode, parsing, JSON serialization, and sorting.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of DefaultMetadataHeaders conform to standard behaviors using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: parseNullMetadataHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks that parsing null input throws a NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: parseEmptyCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that parsing an empty string returns an empty DefaultMetadataHeaders object.

methods.name: parseEmptyJsonArrayCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that parsing an empty JSON array string results in an empty MetadataHeaders collection.

methods.name: parseNonJsonArrayCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that parsing non-JSON array input throws a JsonParseException.

methods.name: parseValidSingleMetadataEntry
methods.description: Tests parsing a JSON array containing a single valid MetadataHeader.

methods.name: parseValidMultipleMetadataEntries
methods.description: Tests parsing a JSON array containing multiple MetadataHeader entries and verifies object equality.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON array representation.

methods.name: metadataHeadersIsSortedByDefault
methods.description: Confirms that the DefaultMetadataHeaders collection sorts the headers by default.
